name: Movenpick Resort & Spa Bintan Lagoon
short_description: A 408-room resort in Lagoi, Bintan, with five dining venues, lagoon-style pools, access to two golf courses, and 2,000sqm of meeting space.
ai_summary: Movenpick Resort & Spa Bintan Lagoon sits in the Lagoi resort belt on Bintan's north coast, offering 408 rooms alongside five distinct dining venues including the all-day Port 19 and the Soñada Beach Club. The resort features lagoon-style pools, the Recreation Village fitness center, Shantara Spa & Wellness, access to two world-class golf courses, and 2,000sqm of meeting space anchored by a 900sqm pillarless Grand Ballroom. Guests consistently praise the spacious, clean rooms and relaxed island atmosphere, with the resort's family-friendly amenities drawing particular praise.

faqs.answer: In the Lagoi resort belt on Bintan's north coast, Indonesia, with access to two world-class golf courses and lagoon-style pools.
